documents.title: CAE Service Solutions
documents.content: Shiretechnik provides comprehensive CAE service solutions that help businesses innovate, reduce development time, and minimize risks. Our expertise in simulation and analysis tools allows us to support engineering teams at every stage of product design and development, ensuring reliable and high-performance outcomes. Our service focus areas include Thermal Design Services, HVAC Design Services, Mechanical Design Services, and Structural Design Services. Our CAE expertise covers Finite Element Analysis (FEA), Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD), Multibody Dynamics (MBD), Fatigue and Durability Analysis, Optimization and Design Exploration, and Thermal and Electromagnetic Analysis.

documents.title: Thermal Design Services
documents.content: Shiretechnik's Thermal Design Services provide advanced thermal simulation and analysis to help engineers optimize heat transfer, thermal management, and thermal performance across products and systems. Our thermal design experts support projects from component level through to full system thermal analysis, ensuring designs meet thermal safety and performance requirements before physical prototypes are created. Services cover conjugate heat transfer modelling, thermal management for electronics, battery systems, and industrial equipment.

documents.title: HVAC Design Services
documents.content: Shiretechnik's HVAC Design Services deliver advanced airflow and thermal simulation for building services projects covering ventilation, thermal comfort, indoor air quality, cleanrooms, and cooling systems. Our HVAC design experts translate mechanical designs into accurate simulation models, evaluate comfort against ASHRAE and ISO standards, and size and verify ventilation strategies for residential, commercial, and industrial buildings. Our services support architects, MEP consultants, and building owners throughout the design process.

documents.title: Mechanical Design Services
documents.content: Shiretechnik's Mechanical Design Services provide comprehensive mechanical simulation and analysis to support product design and development. Our mechanical engineering experts deliver solutions across multibody dynamics, fatigue and durability analysis, optimization and design exploration, and general mechanical system analysis. We help engineering teams validate designs, optimize performance, and reduce development risk before physical prototypes are built, ensuring reliable and high-performance mechanical products.

documents.title: Structural Design Services
documents.content: Shiretechnik's Structural Design Services provide advanced structural simulation and analysis using Finite Element Analysis (FEA) to optimize product performance and ensure structural integrity. Our structural engineering experts deliver detailed stress, vibration, and structural analysis to ensure designs meet strength, safety, and durability standards before physical prototypes are created. Services cover static and dynamic structural analysis, fatigue and durability assessments, and structural optimization for industries including automotive, aerospace, energy, and manufacturing.

documents.title: CAE Expertise
documents.content: Shiretechnik's CAE expertise spans six core service areas. Finite Element Analysis (FEA): optimize product performance with detailed stress, vibration, and structural analysis using advanced FEA tools, ensuring designs meet strength, safety, and durability standards before physical prototypes are created. Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD): advanced flow and thermal simulation across marine, HVAC, fire safety, and electronics domains. Multibody Dynamics (MBD): simulation of mechanical systems with multiple interacting components. Fatigue and Durability Analysis: assess the long-term performance and reliability of components under cyclic loading. Optimization and Design Exploration: systematic exploration of design variables to find optimal solutions. Thermal and Electromagnetic Analysis: detailed thermal and electromagnetic simulation for electronics and industrial systems.

documents.title: CAE Services Industries
documents.content: Shiretechnik provides specialized CAE solutions across various industries. Automotive: enhancing vehicle performance, safety, and fuel efficiency through simulation. Aerospace: supporting structural integrity, aerodynamics, and thermal management for aircraft and space systems. Energy: optimizing systems for wind, solar, and thermal energy sectors. Manufacturing: accelerating the development of efficient, reliable, and durable machinery. Consumer Electronics: ensuring performance and reliability in electronics design through thermal and structural simulation.

documents.title: Benefits of CAE Services
documents.content: The benefits of Shiretechnik's CAE service solutions include: Cost and Time Efficiency — optimize designs early in the development process to reduce costly physical iterations and shorten time to market. Improved Product Performance — deliver higher quality, more reliable products through accurate and detailed simulation. Risk Mitigation — identify and resolve design issues early before they become costly problems in production or field use. Custom Solutions — tailored CAE services designed to meet the specific needs of your project, industry, and engineering team.
